propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket via git blame of the pre-fix state (fixing-commit~1) when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines in file_impact resolve to a single commit with a rebar-ticket trailer.
The --caused-by <id> CLI parameter allows explicit override or specification of caused_by at close time, bypassing auto-derivation.
The closed-source guard in graph._links must be bypassed for auto-derived and explicit caused_by links on closed bugs, using _write_link_event direct-writer path instead of add_dependency.
Auto-derivation returns None (no link) on ambiguity: missing file_impact, no fixing commit found, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable rebar-ticket trailer.
The public library facade transition() must accept and thread a caused_by parameter end-to-end to transition_compute and close_ticket for non-CLI callers.
Ambiguous multi-commit blame cases and cases without a resolvable culprit commit are left to explicit --caused-by or rebar link commands; failure to resolve never blocks the close.
